mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals deteriorating demand growth, which reduces corporate revenue forecasts and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a recessionary labor market, which depresses earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE crosses above 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below 2% annualized signals demand weakness, which reduces corporate revenue forecasts and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 falls below 2% annualized (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1% signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO crosses above 1% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 140 million signals labor market weakness, which depresses consumer spending and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS falls below 140 million (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
